NOTE.name: Off-task, covert

WHISPER.name: Off-task, verbal

audio._comment: Fragments are phrases, and you never hear the phrase. audio.js renders only a phrase's rhythm and contour — one band-passed noise burst per syllable, centre frequency off the vowel — so what arrives is the shape of a sentence at the back of the room and never a word of it. Write what they are actually saying; the room will not give it away.
fragments: he does this every single day
i have it on my phone
my brother had her last year

WHISPER.copy: {a} and {b} have been running a parallel conversation for a while now. It is not about the Missouri Compromise.

QUIET.name: Off-task, covert
QUIET.copy: It's a phone. The thread is with a contact saved as "Mom — cell." The last message is about whether anyone is picking her up today. She is not reading it. She is just holding it.
QUIET.menuHeader: You look longer than you meant to

missedCopy.default: It ran its course on its own. Something in the room shifted and you did not see it.
missedCopy.QUIET: The bell will ring and you will never know that happened.
